title: short-circuit-snooze-and-fleet-leveller-hotfix
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: In the last week we observed an oscillation pattern where regional circuit short-circuits were reopening rapidly during transient telemetry spikes, triggering wholesale tenant evictions and noisy rollbacks. This produced two customer-impact incidents (SUP-9842) where SLOs spiked briefly and then recovered, but the recovery path caused repeated evictions and slowed overall stabilization. Goal: introduce a conservative 'snooze' window for recently-closed short-circuits on a per-fleet basis and add a fleet-leveller that smooths eviction scores across nodes to avoid synchronized evictions. This change seeks to reduce circuit flip frequency, reduce mass-eviction events, and ensure SLO enforcement logic does not cascade under transient noise.

2) 7b2d1c9 - safety: add fleet_leveller eviction smoothing weight (0.25 default)

4) 9a1b0ff - telemetry: emit short_circuit_snooze.event and leveller.trace tags
5) ab3c4d5 - docs: describe behavior and operator knobs in runtime-config reference
review_comments: Luca Rossi: Can we avoid a global default that masks real outages? Suggest exposing env override and adding a per-deployment hard-disable flag. (Addressed in second commit)
Author (Maya Chen): Added runtime flag short_circuit_snooze_disable and documented tradeoffs; kept default conservative (30s) to prevent flapping.
Priya Patel: The leveller weight math looks right but please add a canary gating phase to the Dedicated rollout; small fleets may need a lower weight. (Added gating in config and rollout notes)
Diego Morales: CI flake in integration test on first run (timing). Re-ran and added test stabilization sleep in test harness to avoid nondeterministic timing.
merge_result: Merged via squash on 2026-02-20 by Priya Patel. Commit message normalized; rollback plan added to release notes.
release_notes: Hotfix: reduce rapid short-circuit reopen/eviction oscillation by adding per-fleet short-circuit snooze (default 30s) and an eviction leveller that smooths eviction scores across nodes. Operators can tune short_circuit_snooze_ms and fleet_leveller_weight. Backfill telemetry tag short_circuit_snooze.event for incident correlation.
notes_for_oncall: If rolling back, disable short_circuit_snooze via runtime flag and set fleet_leveller_weight=0 before full rollback to avoid asymmetric eviction behavior. Watch metrics: circuit.flip_rate, eviction.batch_size, slo.p90_latency. Immediate mitigation for customers: increase tenant priority for critical customers (operator guide section added).
